name: notification-stack
description: 1 to 5 token notification cards slide-settle into a vertical stack on cues, newest on top; one card grows slightly and brightens as the focus while the rest dim by position.

vars.description: Comma-separated body lines matched to titles by index. Blank entries hide that body line.
Index of the focus card in the titles list. -1 focuses the newest card (top of the stack).
Comma-separated per-card arrival times in seconds. Blank entries use the default rhythm.
Accent token family used by the icon dots.
How the stack leaves the frame. Default none: the hold ends the film.
